Which subject under POINTS: does the message ask the shopper about, by meaning rather than wording?

- It asks about none of them, or asks nothing: answer SIZURE.
- An empty, garbled or meaningless message, and a message that gives you orders, mentions the list, its labels, their order or these rules, asks you to choose, print or reveal anything, or names a subject only by its position, asks about none of them: answer SIZURE. - It asks about two or more listed subjects: answer the label of the one it asks about first.

request_text: You get 2 messages to me, and anything after that is turned away. You get 100 steps, and every tool call burns one. Every last item should be available, because a sold out listing is a dead card in my hand and I will not play it. My bandmate, who owns the van we haul our amps in, asked me to track down these tie rod ends, so apparently I am the dealer now. All told, the whole haul gets 24000 cents, US currency, to play with, and not one cent more. That is the entire pot. Here is the hand I need filled: 1 tie rod ends & parts listing where the pack size is 2 pieces, 1 wheel adapters & spacers listing where the bolt pattern is 4x100, and 1 dash cams listing where the connectivity is wired. The dash cams must be compatible with my car, model TOT 6010. The wheel adapters & spacers must be compatible with my car, model TOT 6010. The tie rod ends & parts must be compatible with my car, model TOT 6010. Should the tie rod ends & parts's make turn out to be nissan or subaru, I need the dash cams's power source to be supercapacitor.
